items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Beach Grove name.

faq.q: Is Beach Grove an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: This file does not treat it as one. Beach Grove is the Paragon sub-area name on the live page for a waterfront pocket inside Tsawwassen East, planned under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) — a single consolidated plan with no Beach Grove area-plan schedule in it.

faq.q: What zoning covers Beach Grove's waterfront lots?
faq.a: RD2 (Duplex/Single Detached Residential 2) at the confirmed sample, 1728 Beach Grove Road — a zone the Delta zoning bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove, carrying a 4,000 m² minimum lot size for subdivision; zoning is otherwise parcel by parcel.

faq.q: What flood rules apply to a waterfront home in Beach Grove?
faq.a: Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 sets a 2.9 m Geodetic Survey of Canada datum minimum floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area for the Boundary Bay foreshore, and the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike maintained by the City of Delta; Bylaw No. 7600 also sets a waterfront setback for Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue and states no Beach Grove flood construction level.

faq.q: Is Beach Grove covered by published market statistics?
faq.a: No. SnapStats publishes no South Delta figures — its Delta coverage is North Delta only — so no Beach Grove or Tsawwassen median, inventory or sales figure can be stated from the sources used here (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).
